block.comment: Purpose: Attach an external interrupt to count input edges. Hardware: use Connections to check pin ownership for your selected board. Open the comment bubbles on the main steps for explanations.
Create pulseCount as uint16_t. Outside a body it is global; inside a function/setup/loop it belongs to that body. Its value input is the initial value.
